_comment: Baseline figures behind index.html. The hourly refresh re-queries HubSpot, diffs against this file, patches index.html where a figure moved, and commits both. Do not hand-edit without updating index.html to match.

lifecycle._excluded_test_record_note: Arushi Test 1 (Enablement), Test Company Record (Selling), Test Company (Identification), Test Company Record 2 (Identification) carry company_type = Partner and are excluded from every count above per runbook §5. Counting them reads 49 in lifecycle.

Stale as at this commit: the Tile 4 note still cites £77,100 and 'seven of eleven'; the Beamery insight still cites 'six of this year's fifteen deals and £69,100'; the records-to-fix note still describes a single TEST deal rather than four Test company records; 'Candidates by type and stage' still reads 36 unsigned against a lifecycle of 45, and its type bars need partner__type, which is not in the runbook §1 query set.
_timestamp_format: Header stamp shows GMT only. Never IST, never London. It records the last successful HubSpot read, whether or not any figure changed.
